why: The triangle, circle and square move one place round each time, so the order repeats every 3 figures: figure 4 has the same places as figure 1, and figure 5 must have the places of figure 2 (circle on top, square left, triangle right). The centre sign changed from x to + in figure 4 and stays +. Option 4 fits both. Option 2 has the right places but the old x sign.
trick: Track each small shape on its own, and also check the sign in the middle.
